messages: Lina: quick design sync — want feedback on the rollout scrub + copy adjustments before we lock it. main concerns: SR announce order, rollback affordance placement, and timeline cheat-sheet copy. Ava: visually it's tight and reads fine. SR/keyboard flow worries me though: when scrubbing with arrows VoiceOver sometimes announces only the numeric value, not the label. we need a combined announce. Diego: agree. solution: keep a single hidden live region that updates with a full sentence: 'Version v1.2.3, deployed 2 hours ago, live, actions: promote, rollback'. minimize updates on rapid scrubs (debounce 150ms). Lina: good. can you paste the minimal pattern? Diego: snippet: ```html Version v1.2.3, deployed 2 hours ago, live ``` Ava: also add role="status"? some ATs prefer it. and debounce as mentioned. Matt: on rollback/button placement: we must avoid accidental rollbacks for PMs but keep one-click for SRE during incidents. propose: show 'Rollback' inline for users with 'Can rollback' permission, and behind a small chevron+menu for others. incident workflow: an incident banner can surface a one-click emergency rollback (requires SSO confirmation). Sam: permissions-based UI is ok but test flow for keyboard users. if rollback is inline it still needs a confirm modal for keyboard activation. hold-to-confirm for mouse only as progressive enhancement. Ava: copy tweak: instead of 'Promote to 100%' use 'Promote to full traffic' — clearer for non-metric folks. status label under slider: 'Canary — gradual traffic over 10 minutes (editable)'. Lina: new button layout suggestion: primary = 'Promote to full traffic', secondary = 'Schedule rollout', tertiary/danger = 'Rollback' (danger style). add tooltip on rollback: 'Revert traffic to the previously active version. Requires confirmation.' Matt: timeline scrub cheatsheet: small hover-help text: 'Use ←/→ to scrub history, Enter to open details, Esc to exit'. put it under the timeline area in a muted style. Also add a visual focus ring for keyboard scrubbing so users can see the scrub focus. Diego: perf note: timeline redraw triggers heavy canvas operations. throttle redraw to 60fps and debounce keyboard scrubs to 100ms; I will file PERF-1289. Lina: filed PERF-1289. Accessibility order decision: when announcing a scrubbable item it should read: version id, relative time, status, and available actions. example announce: 'Version v2.0.1, deployed 3 hours ago, rolled back, actions: promote'. Ava: I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA passes tomorrow and post results. Sam: modal behavior: when rollback modal opens, focus should land on the heading; cancel should be the first tabbable action; confirm should be primary and last. aria-describedby on confirm to include the undo window text. Lina: small microcopy change: under version history add 'Tip: hover or use keyboard to scrub past versions. Restoring will route traffic back to the chosen version.' Matt: tooltip language nit: 'Revert traffic to previously active version' -> consider 'Return traffic to the previously active version (no code changes)'. DeployBot: staging deployment: rollout-scrub-a11y-update deployed by Lina — preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/rollout/preview/2041256789 Lina: thanks all — I'll update Figma with copy and aria-live pattern, tag @Diego @Ava @Sam for follow-ups. Ava: will do SR runs and post checklist here. :sparkles: Matt: once SR + perf are green, let's ship.
